citations.source: 李學勤主編,《字源》, 天津古籍出版社／遼寧人民出版社, 2012
citations.field: 小 headword; PDF p. 76, printed p. 64; scanned headword and continuation checked on PDF p. 77, printed p. 65
citations.text: The scanned entry identifies 小 as pictographic and interprets its marks as tiny grains of dust or sand, calling it an early graph of 沙; it says the graph was extended to mean ‘small,’ opposite 大, and gives that sense in oracle-bone and bronze inscriptions. It cites 《粹》1004 for 小雨, then describes extensions to low status, contempt, and youth. It says the current form was corrupted in bronze inscriptions and treats Shuowen’s 八-plus-丨 account as an explanation of that altered form. The adjacent 少 entry says 小 and 少 were originally one graph, with similar use in oracle-bone texts, and later differentiated; its explanation continues onto printed p. 65. Direct scan inspection confirms the cited headword and passage. Forms checked against pixels: 小, 少, 沙, 八, 丨, 大, and the text’s citation 《粹》1004. The scan supports what this author asserts; it does not settle the disputed sand-grain interpretation.
